english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for firing a gun or launching a projectile, including shooting at a target.
Use this for sending a rocket or other projectile upward into flight.

examples.english: I shoot at targets with an air rifle.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 hei3 coeng1 se6 baa2

examples.english: The rocket will launch into the sky as soon as the countdown ends.
examples.traditional: 支火箭倒數完就射上天。
examples.jyutping: zi1 fo2 zin3 dou2 sou3 jyun4 zau6 se6 soeng5 tin1
